mechanism: Naproxen may increase cardiovascular risk in amphetamine users by reducing renal prostaglandin-mediated vasodilation, while lisdexamfetamine increases sympathomimetic activity; additionally, NSAIDs can reduce renal function affecting amphetamine clearance.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate regularly; consider alternative analgesics (acetaminophen, selective COX-2 inhibitors with caution); ensure adequate hydration and renal function monitoring.
